description: Save facts the user tells you about themselves into their profile fields (birthday, city, role, company stage and the like). `values` maps field_id to the new value; an empty string clears a field. Call with an empty `values` to list every field with its id, type, allowed options and current value. For name, headline, timezone, website, LinkedIn URL or X handle use update_my_profile instead.
name: update_profile_fields
title: Update profile fields
